answer: Quadratic endorsement pricing: every established agent may cosign new identities, but each successive endorsement within one epoch costs quadratically more - the first cheap, the tenth a hundredfold. A whisper of fakes stays affordable, but a flood bankrupts the farmer. Reputation passes through each endorsement like light through a prism, refracted against the sponsor's own standing, so spam-endorsing drags the cosigner to the nadir of trust. A sybil operator pays the quadratic toll per fake and burns real reputation on each, while one honest agent needs only a single affordable cosignature.
